name: wds_vtab-pcam
description: wds_vtab-pcam provides the PatchCamelyon (PCam) task packaged for few-shot/transfer evaluation in the CLIP/VTAB-style workflow. It measures a model's ability to classify histopathology image patches (tumor vs. normal) under transfer or limited-data settings. Typical use is to evaluate visual representation quality and downstream adaptation performance on a medical imaging classification task.
reputation: A focused histopathology patch classification task derived from PatchCamelyon, commonly used in transfer/few-shot vision evaluations with moderate adoption in research.
